title: Data and Storage Module
summary: This module manages persistent application data, user settings, chat history, and handles the storage and caching of AI model artifacts in various formats, including GGUF.

nodes.label: Application Store
nodes.title: Application Store
nodes.description: Manages persistent application data such as user settings, unique identifiers, chat history, and window configurations.

nodes.label: GGUF File Writer
nodes.title: GGUF File Writer
nodes.description: Handles the serialization and writing of AI model weights and metadata into the GGUF (GGML Universal File Format).

nodes.label: Blob Cache
nodes.title: Blob Cache
nodes.description: Provides a content-addressable storage mechanism for binary large objects (blobs), managing their storage, retrieval, and associated manifests.

nodes.label: Registry Client
nodes.title: Registry Client
nodes.description: Manages the linking and unlinking of model artifacts within a registry, typically interacting with the blob cache for storage.

nodes.label: Application Core
nodes.title: Application Core
nodes.description: The main application logic that interacts with various data storage components to manage state and user interactions.

nodes.label: Model Management
nodes.title: Model Management
nodes.description: Components responsible for creating, converting, and managing AI models, including their data storage and lifecycle.

nodes.label: File System
nodes.title: Operating System File System
nodes.description: The underlying operating system file system used for persistent storage by various components.

groups.label: Application Data Storage
groups.title: Application Data Storage
groups.description: Manages user-specific application settings, chat history, and other persistent state.

groups.label: Model Data & Cache Management
groups.title: Model Data & Cache Management
groups.description: Handles the storage, caching, and registry management of AI model artifacts and their associated metadata.
